question: We selected a random sample among patients who come for flu vaccination during the annual campaign in a health center. It is recorded in selected patients if they are using lipid-lowering drugs and if they are diagnosed with diabetes mellitus, among other data. It is obtained that diabetes mellitus is more frequent among patients taking lipid-lowering drugs than among those who do not take them. Which of the following corresponds to the design of this study?
analysis: The study design described involves selecting a random sample of patients and recording their current status regarding the use of lipid-lowering drugs and the presence of diabetes mellitus. This is characteristic of a prevalence study, which assesses the frequency of a condition (diabetes mellitus) in a population at a specific point in time and its association with another factor (use of lipid-lowering drugs). There is no indication of a temporal sequence or follow-up, which rules out cohort or prospective studies, and there is no mention of selecting cases and controls based on outcome, which rules out a case-control study. Randomization is not mentioned, ruling out a randomized clinical trial.
